title: Delete or wire up the dead MonthlyActivitySliverCalendar spike widget
rule: Dead code / AG-4 duplicate top-level name

evidence.quote: /// This widget is **not wired into any screen yet** — it is a layout proof of

why: The device-freeze problem this widget was built to solve (~9,600 daily cells for an All Time streak calendar) was actually solved a different way: recent_activity_screen.dart swaps in a totals-only _AllTimeSummaryCard for the All Time range instead of ever rendering a per-day grid. So this 404-line widget — plus its own hand-rolled MonthlyActivityRollup class, which duplicates the name of the real Drift-generated MonthlyActivityRollup in core/database/tables/monthly_activity_rollups.dart (its own doc comment at lines 4-12 flags this as a temporary stand-in to delete once wired in) — has no live caller and is exercised only by its own dedicated spike test. It sits in lib/ counting toward file-size/symbol-count backlogs for a problem the team already solved elsewhere.
recommendation: Delete monthly_activity_sliver_calendar.dart and its spike test, or file a follow-up to actually wire it in and delete the hand-rolled MonthlyActivityRollup DTO in favor of the generated one. Don't leave a superseded proof-of-concept in the production lib/ tree.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn MonthlyActivitySliverCalendar lib/ finds either zero results (deleted) or a real screen-level caller (wired in).

corrections: Doc-comment quote 'not wired into any screen yet' is actually at line 66, not the cited line 64 (2-line miscite, text itself verbatim correct). The AG-4 'duplicates the name of the real Drift-generated MonthlyActivityRollup class' overstates present tense: that generated class doesn't exist yet (table was never added to a table list, so build_runner never emitted it) — today there is only one class named MonthlyActivityRollup in lib/, so it's a latent future collision, not a current AG-4 violation.
